# eval-harness-mini

> Minimal evaluation harness: golden JSONL datasets, built-in scorers, CI pass thresholds, a stable JSON report and an opt-in pytest plugin. Python package `trysac-eval-harness-mini`, import name `eval_harness_mini`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API

- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
